info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API allows consumers to access information about various partnerships related to hotel loyalty points. This endpoint is essential for developers building applications that integrate loyalty programs and enhance customer engagement. Users can retrieve a list of partners offering loyalty points, which can be useful for travel booking platforms, mobile apps, and loyalty program management systems. The API aims to facilitate seamless integration of loyalty features into consumer applications, improving user experience and driving customer retention.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of point partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of partners associated with the points system. You can use this to identify which partners are currently available and how they contribute to the points ecosystem.
